title: Fixed-temperature soft optimization has standard nonconvex stationary guarantees
statement: A positive-temperature softmax affine-max family is smooth on the regular region; line-search gradient/quasi-Newton methods can be monotone in the soft objective and converge only to standard stationary notions.

proof_location.section: S4. Fixed-temperature soft optimization has ordinary stationary-point guarantees

warning: This gives no hard local/global optimality guarantee.
